Timothy




Private owner • From Marbella, Spain • JoinedJune 2023







I have lived in Spain for over 20 years and enjoy many facets of Spanish life, not least the weather - especially in winter.
I have been actively involved in renting apartments in Spain since I moved here, but since retiring, I only rent out this apartment (which is where I live) when I go in search of cooler and less busy places in the summer months.
My colleague handles all physical aspects of your rental, from gathering passport details, checking them when you arrive and registering them with the National Police (law).
He also checks you out of the apartment and organises the cleaning of it, whilst also checking for damages or other things necessary during and between lettings.
He is British, but is a fluent Spanish speaker and he is there for you 24/7 should you need his help in any way.
The apartment, as I mentioned in my opening description is in a family neighbourhood, with most adults having permanent jobs, so quietness between the hours of midnight and 8am is appreciated or even imperative, as they have to sleep before going to work!
Please ensure there is no smoking anywhere in the apartment and leave it as best you can in the condition that you found it (forgiving some dirt and dust etc!).
